## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

## How do our numbing products work?

Our tattoo numbing creams & sprays work by blocking pain signals in the area it has been applied
from reaching the brain. This works by numbing the surface of the skin for a short period of time
(up to 3-4 hours), which offers highly effective pain relief for your tattoo session or other
procedure.

## What else can numbing cream be used for?

Other uses for our products include: Semi permanent tattooing, Laser Hair Removal, Waxing,
Injections, Blood tests, Vaccinations, Lip Fillers, Permanent Makeup, Piercings and other cosmetic
skin treatments. It can be used to numb any area of the skin so the potential possibilities for it
are endless!

## How long does numbing cream last for?

should be applied at least 30-60 minutes before a tattooing session for it to have maximum effect.

Search for a company, add reports to your cart, proceed to checkout, and pay securely by credit

# HAMMERSMITH TATTOO LONDON

## Professional Tattooing Since 2007

[BOOK AN APPOINTMENT ][15]

## About Studio

Founded in 2007, Hammersmith Tattoo London has earned its place as  a leading studio on West
London's North End Road, blending award wining craftsmanship with a reputation for quality,
creativity and care.


With over decade of industry experience, we've been recognised at both UK and international tattoo
conventions, reflecting the skill and passion of our dedicated [artists][16].

Our diverse team specialises in a broad spectrum of styles from[ fine-line][17] and realism to
illustrative and custom designes ensuring every client receives work tailored to their vision.

At Hammersmith Tattoo, we believe in honest guidance, creative collaboration, and delivering tattoos
you'll be proud of for life.

## Opening Hours

Mon 11am - 7pm

Tue - Sat 11am - 8pm

Sun 12pm - 6pm

For the most up-to-date information on our opening hours, including holidays, special events, and
bank holidays place check our [Google Business Page][18].

We regularly update it to reflect any changes to our schedule.

For detailed news and announcements about our hours, visit the [Blog][19] section on our website, we
keep it current so you'll always know when we're open.

Stay connected for the latest updates, and we look forward to welcoming you at Hammersmith Tattoo
London!

## Walk-in Tattoos

No Appointment? No Problem.


Looking for a spontaneous tattoo? Whether it's a flash design or a quick custom piece, our artists
at Hammersmith Tattoo London are ready to welcome walk-ins every day.

For the best possible experience, we recommend calling us at [020 7602 1086][20] before you visit.
This allows us to check [artist][21] availability and make sure we can give you tattoo the time and
attention it deserves.

Prefer to drop by? You're always welcome. Out team will do their best to accommodate you on the
spot.

Because great tattoos shouldn't have to wait.

## Reviews

Discover why we're a top choice for tattoos at Hammersmith Tattoo London! Check out our Google page
where more than 700 reviews have given us a 5-star rating. These testimonials reflect the high
quality and exceptional craftsmanship of our work. Visit now to see why our clients consistently
rate us so highly!

[GOOGLE REVIEWS ][22]

## Best Tattoo Shops in London 2025

Hammersmith Tattoo is widely acclaimed and proudly featured on the Best Tattoo Shops in London list.

[LIST][23]

## Tattoo Styles
## Your Vision, Our Craft

At Hammersmith Tattoo London, we believe every tattoo is a personal story waiting to be told. That's
why our studio brings together a team experienced [artists][24], each specialising in distinct
styles from [fine-line][25], realism, and [blackwork][26] to [traditional][27],[
neo-traditional][28], [Japanese][29], geometric, and illustrative [designs][30].

Whether you have a clear vision or seek creative guidance, our [artists][31] work with you to craft
a design that reflects your individuality. We combine artistic excellence with precise technique to
ensure every piece is unique, high quality, and made to last.

With a strong commitment to professionalism, hygiene, and a welcoming atmosphere, we provide a safe
environment where creativity thrives.

Step into Hammersmith Tattoo London where ideas become art, and [styles][32] meet craftmanship.

# HAMMERSMITH TATTOO LONDON

## Professional Tattooing Since 2007

[BOOK AN APPOINTMENT ][15]

## About Studio

Founded in 2007, Hammersmith Tattoo London has earned its place as  a leading studio on West
London's North End Road, blending award wining craftsmanship with a reputation for quality,
creativity and care.


With over decade of industry experience, we've been recognised at both UK and international tattoo
conventions, reflecting the skill and passion of our dedicated [artists][16].

Our diverse team specialises in a broad spectrum of styles from[ fine-line][17] and realism to
illustrative and custom designes ensuring every client receives work tailored to their vision.

At Hammersmith Tattoo, we believe in honest guidance, creative collaboration, and delivering tattoos
you'll be proud of for life.

## Opening Hours

Mon 11am - 7pm

Tue - Sat 11am - 8pm

Sun 12pm - 6pm

For the most up-to-date information on our opening hours, including holidays, special events, and
bank holidays place check our [Google Business Page][18].

We regularly update it to reflect any changes to our schedule.

For detailed news and announcements about our hours, visit the [Blog][19] section on our website, we
keep it current so you'll always know when we're open.

Stay connected for the latest updates, and we look forward to welcoming you at Hammersmith Tattoo
London!

## Walk-in Tattoos

No Appointment? No Problem.


Looking for a spontaneous tattoo? Whether it's a flash design or a quick custom piece, our artists
at Hammersmith Tattoo London are ready to welcome walk-ins every day.

For the best possible experience, we recommend calling us at [020 7602 1086][20] before you visit.
This allows us to check [artist][21] availability and make sure we can give you tattoo the time and
attention it deserves.

Prefer to drop by? You're always welcome. Out team will do their best to accommodate you on the
spot.

Because great tattoos shouldn't have to wait.

## Reviews

Discover why we're a top choice for tattoos at Hammersmith Tattoo London! Check out our Google page
where more than 700 reviews have given us a 5-star rating. These testimonials reflect the high
quality and exceptional craftsmanship of our work. Visit now to see why our clients consistently
rate us so highly!

[GOOGLE REVIEWS ][22]

## Best Tattoo Shops in London 2025

Hammersmith Tattoo is widely acclaimed and proudly featured on the Best Tattoo Shops in London list.

[LIST][23]

## Tattoo Styles
## Your Vision, Our Craft

At Hammersmith Tattoo London, we believe every tattoo is a personal story waiting to be told. That's
why our studio brings together a team experienced [artists][24], each specialising in distinct
styles from [fine-line][25], realism, and [blackwork][26] to [traditional][27],[
neo-traditional][28], [Japanese][29], geometric, and illustrative [designs][30].

Whether you have a clear vision or seek creative guidance, our [artists][31] work with you to craft
a design that reflects your individuality. We combine artistic excellence with precise technique to
ensure every piece is unique, high quality, and made to last.

With a strong commitment to professionalism, hygiene, and a welcoming atmosphere, we provide a safe
environment where creativity thrives.

Step into Hammersmith Tattoo London where ideas become art, and [styles][32] meet craftmanship.

## Get Numbed. Stay Focused. Enjoy Your Tattoo

Don’t let pain ruin your session. Choose a trusted numbing cream used by thousands before their
tattoos. Fast-acting, reliable, and available in multiple options to match your needs.

## Most Popular Questions

### How do I know I’m buying authentic TKTX?


We are an **official TKTX supplier**, and all our products come sealed, labeled, and batch verified.
Buying from trusted sellers like us guarantees you're using **authentic tattoo numbing
cream** that’s effective and safe.


### How long will the cream last once opened?


If the cream has been opened please discard after 2 weeks as once the cream has been exposed to air
it will not be as effective to numb.


### My numbness is wearing off and I have a red rash?

When the initial numbness sets in, the skin should go more pale if anything. But when the feeling
comes back its totally normal for the skin to turn redish as the blood vessels widen back up.


### How much will one tube TKTX cover?


The tubes are 10g and need to be applied nice and thick! 2 full tubes would only be enough to cover
a full forearm.


### Will TKTX completely numb the area?


All people are different and have different levels of numbing but as long as you apply correctly it
should fully numb the area for the majority of people. See the review section for more information!


### What if I have no cling film?


Sandwich bags taped with masking tape work well too. If you cant use anything like that you may find
it doesn’t fully numb the area or the numb doesn’t last as long as it should.


### How do I apply the cream?

Do not consume alcohol or drink excess amounts of milk and caffeine

We are an **official TKTX supplier**, and all our products come sealed, labeled, and batch verified.
Buying from trusted sellers like us guarantees you're using **authentic tattoo numbing
cream** that’s effective and safe.


### How long will the cream last once opened?


If the cream has been opened please discard after 2 weeks as once the cream has been exposed to air
it will not be as effective to numb.


### My numbness is wearing off and I have a red rash?

When the initial numbness sets in, the skin should go more pale if anything. But when the feeling
comes back its totally normal for the skin to turn redish as the blood vessels widen back up.


### How much will one tube TKTX cover?


The tubes are 10g and need to be applied nice and thick! 2 full tubes would only be enough to cover
a full forearm.


### Will TKTX completely numb the area?


All people are different and have different levels of numbing but as long as you apply correctly it
should fully numb the area for the majority of people. See the review section for more information!


### What if I have no cling film?


Sandwich bags taped with masking tape work well too. If you cant use anything like that you may find
it doesn’t fully numb the area or the numb doesn’t last as long as it should.


### How do I apply the cream?

Do not consume alcohol or drink excess amounts of milk and caffeine 24 hours before using.

APPLY TO UNBROKEN SKIN
– Wash hands thoroughly
– Remove any excessive hair
– Make sure the area is clean, dry and not cold!
– Spread a thick layer over the area, around 2-3mm thick! Don’t rub it in!
– Cover it with plastic film – make sure its air tight, but not too tight. Masking tape is great for
awkward places! (this process can prevent evaporation while encouraging slow and proper -absorption
into the skin
– Wash your hands thoroughly after application !
– Leave for 1 hour
– Remove the film, wipe/clean the area (your artist/nurse will probably do this for you)

Only apply the cream to exterior skin

### Will the TKTX cream affect my ink?

affected at all!


### Is TKTX safe for all skin types?


Yes, TKTX is dermatologically tested and safe for most skin types. However, if you have sensitive
skin, allergies, or any medical conditions, we recommend doing a patch test before full use or
consulting your doctor.


### How long does the numbness last?

The numbing effect usually lasts between **3 to 6 hours**, depending on skin type, body area, and
how well the product was applied. For longer tattoo sessions, reapplication may be necessary, but
only under professional guidance.


### What is TKTX Cream?


TKTX Cream is a topical anesthetic designed to reduce pain and discomfort during procedures like
tattoos, PMU, microneedling, laser treatments, waxing, and more. It desensitizes the skin, making
long or sensitive sessions easier to manage.


### How long does TKTX take to work?


TKTX typically starts to work within **45 to 60 minutes** after application. It's important to apply
it correctly and cover the area with plastic wrap to activate the cream and ensure maximum
effectiveness.

[PDO Threads vs PCL Threads][119]

Thread lifting has emerged as an alternative to a non-surgical facelift. The aesthetic medicine
market is dominated by two major thread types: PDO and PCL. The two offer aesthetic benefits by
using minimal procedures to rejuvenate the face. Nonetheless, they differ significantly in
composition, duration, and lifting capacity. When practitioners and patients understand these
differences, critical treatment decisions can be reached. Learning about Thread Lift Foundations  
What Thread Lifts Do Thread lifts involve the placement of medical-grade threads beneath the skin to
lift sagging tissue. The threads provide instant mechanical raising and also activate collagen
regeneration. The combination of the two produces both immediate and gradual outcomes. How They Work
Practitioners insert needles through punctures to place threads. The fibers fasten to tissue, which
produces tension upwards. New collagen is then formed around the threads as the body reacts to them.
Even dissolved threads still produce this collagen. Common Treatment Areas Thread lifts treat the
brow, neck, mid-face, and jowls. Hanging cheeks, jaws, and neck skin are also good candidates for
treatment. The durability of thread lifts renders them suitable against addressing several
age-related issues.   PDO Threads Explained   Material Composition PDO is an acronym for
polydioxanone, a synthetic absorbable suture. Medical practitioners have been using PDO in surgery
for decades. The safety profiles have been developed with a solid medical experience background.
Absorption Timeline PDO threads disintegrate after 6 to 8 months of insertion. The body's natural
hydrolytic processes break them down. Despite the disappearance of threads, collagen production
continues to yield steady returns. Types of PDO Threads Mono threads are smooth and mainly stimulate
collagen. The barbs on the cog threads provide mechanical lift. Screw thread comprises interlaced
strands to improve volume. Each type has a specific purpose.   PCL Threads Explained   Material
Composition PCL is an abbreviation for polycaprolactone, an additional biocompatible synthetic
polymer. PCL degrades more slowly than PDO. The material is used in different medical equipment and
implants. Absorption Timeline PCL threads take 12 to 24 months to be fully absorbed by the tissue.
The extended stay offers mechanical support at a longer length. The slow deterioration ensures a
lift during absorption. Thread Structure PCL threads are usually barbed to provide a firm grip in
the tissues. Barbs are more effective at engaging tissue than smooth surfaces. This forceful
anchoring generates strong, short-acting lifting effects.   Lifting Power Comparison   Immediate
Lift Results The immediate lifting is mainly stronger due to the robust structure of the PCL
threads. The material's structural rigidity produces more dramatic initial outcomes. PDO threads
provide less dramatic and immediate lifting. You can sometimes confuse it for PCL Fillers that
contain the same material, but are injectable gels that add volume and subtly stimulate collagen in
your body. Tissue Engagement PCL barbs are firmer against tissue than PDO alternatives. This
enhanced involvement results in greater mechanical lifting. The increase in strength averts slipping
and increases the correction time. Weight-Bearing Capacity PCL threads can withstand greater tissue
weight without deformation. Heavy sagging is more sensitive to PCL's structural integrity. PDO
threads are suitable for light lifting requirements and sensitive regions.   Longevity of Results  
Duration Differences The PCL threads retain their structure twice as long as PDO threads. This
prolongs the stay, resulting in a prolonged mechanical lift. PCL treatments usually last 18-24
months, whereas PDO treatments last 12-18 months. Collagen Stimulation Both types of threads
stimulate collagen. Nonetheless, the longer history of PCL offers a prolonged stimulation. The
increased long-lasting collagen synthesis leads to improved long-term outcomes. Maintenance Needs
The PCL can be durable enough to minimize the rate of maintenance therapy. Lower long-term
medication use would translate into reduced expenses. PDO can require more frequent touch-ups to
maintain the desired results.   Safety Considerations   Biocompatibility PDO and PCL have excellent
biocompatibility. Both materials have a low likelihood of having adverse reactions. Both are well
tolerated by the body and cause minimal inflammation. Side Effect Profiles PDO and PCL have similar
side effects, which include bruises, swelling, and temporary dimpling. There is no considerable
difference between the risks presented by both. The materials have minimal complications, though
proper technique reduces them. Regulatory Approval The two types of threads have medical device
approvals in key markets. Safety and efficacy are accepted by regulatory means. Practitioners are
required to check the status of regional approval.   Patient Comfort   Insertion Process The
increased stiffness of PCL threads may also make insertion somewhat more uncomfortable. Flexible PDO
installation may permit a gentler installation. Both types of local anesthesia treat discomfort.
Post-Treatment Sensation PCL threads are also stiffer and may be perceived more significantly by
patients in the beginning. The PDO threads also tend to be less noticeable because the threads
become softer. For better quality and fast delivery times, you can contact this PDO thread supplier.
The majority of sensations fade within days, regardless of the thread type. Recovery Experience Both
types of threads have similar recovery timelines. Swelling and bruising generally resolve in 1 week.
The stiffer structure of PCL can result in a slightly longer adjustment.   Cost Considerations  
Treatment Pricing PCL threads are usually more expensive than PDO threads per treatment. The
increase in material costs and the resulting durability should justify higher prices. PDO has
lower-cost alternatives.

[PDO Threads vs PCL Threads][119]

Thread lifting has emerged as an alternative to a non-surgical facelift. The aesthetic medicine
market is dominated by two major thread types: PDO and PCL. The two offer aesthetic benefits by
using minimal procedures to rejuvenate the face. Nonetheless, they differ significantly in
composition, duration, and lifting capacity. When practitioners and patients understand these
differences, critical treatment decisions can be reached. Learning about Thread Lift Foundations  
What Thread Lifts Do Thread lifts involve the placement of medical-grade threads beneath the skin to
lift sagging tissue. The threads provide instant mechanical raising and also activate collagen
regeneration. The combination of the two produces both immediate and gradual outcomes. How They Work
Practitioners insert needles through punctures to place threads. The fibers fasten to tissue, which
produces tension upwards. New collagen is then formed around the threads as the body reacts to them.
Even dissolved threads still produce this collagen. Common Treatment Areas Thread lifts treat the
brow, neck, mid-face, and jowls. Hanging cheeks, jaws, and neck skin are also good candidates for
treatment. The durability of thread lifts renders them suitable against addressing several
age-related issues.   PDO Threads Explained   Material Composition PDO is an acronym for
polydioxanone, a synthetic absorbable suture. Medical practitioners have been using PDO in surgery
for decades. The safety profiles have been developed with a solid medical experience background.
Absorption Timeline PDO threads disintegrate after 6 to 8 months of insertion. The body's natural
hydrolytic processes break them down. Despite the disappearance of threads, collagen production
continues to yield steady returns. Types of PDO Threads Mono threads are smooth and mainly stimulate
collagen. The barbs on the cog threads provide mechanical lift. Screw thread comprises interlaced
strands to improve volume. Each type has a specific purpose.   PCL Threads Explained   Material
Composition PCL is an abbreviation for polycaprolactone, an additional biocompatible synthetic
polymer. PCL degrades more slowly than PDO. The material is used in different medical equipment and
implants. Absorption Timeline PCL threads take 12 to 24 months to be fully absorbed by the tissue.
The extended stay offers mechanical support at a longer length. The slow deterioration ensures a
lift during absorption. Thread Structure PCL threads are usually barbed to provide a firm grip in
the tissues. Barbs are more effective at engaging tissue than smooth surfaces. This forceful
anchoring generates strong, short-acting lifting effects.   Lifting Power Comparison   Immediate
Lift Results The immediate lifting is mainly stronger due to the robust structure of the PCL
threads. The material's structural rigidity produces more dramatic initial outcomes. PDO threads
provide less dramatic and immediate lifting. You can sometimes confuse it for PCL Fillers that
contain the same material, but are injectable gels that add volume and subtly stimulate collagen in
your body. Tissue Engagement PCL barbs are firmer against tissue than PDO alternatives. This
enhanced involvement results in greater mechanical lifting. The increase in strength averts slipping
and increases the correction time. Weight-Bearing Capacity PCL threads can withstand greater tissue
weight without deformation. Heavy sagging is more sensitive to PCL's structural integrity. PDO
threads are suitable for light lifting requirements and sensitive regions.   Longevity of Results  
Duration Differences The PCL threads retain their structure twice as long as PDO threads. This
prolongs the stay, resulting in a prolonged mechanical lift. PCL treatments usually last 18-24
months, whereas PDO treatments last 12-18 months. Collagen Stimulation Both types of threads
stimulate collagen. Nonetheless, the longer history of PCL offers a prolonged stimulation. The
increased long-lasting collagen synthesis leads to improved long-term outcomes. Maintenance Needs
The PCL can be durable enough to minimize the rate of maintenance therapy. Lower long-term
medication use would translate into reduced expenses. PDO can require more frequent touch-ups to
maintain the desired results.   Safety Considerations   Biocompatibility PDO and PCL have excellent
biocompatibility. Both materials have a low likelihood of having adverse reactions. Both are well
tolerated by the body and cause minimal inflammation. Side Effect Profiles PDO and PCL have similar
side effects, which include bruises, swelling, and temporary dimpling. There is no considerable
difference between the risks presented by both. The materials have minimal complications, though
proper technique reduces them. Regulatory Approval The two types of threads have medical device
approvals in key markets. Safety and efficacy are accepted by regulatory means. Practitioners are
required to check the status of regional approval.   Patient Comfort   Insertion Process The
increased stiffness of PCL threads may also make insertion somewhat more uncomfortable. Flexible PDO
installation may permit a gentler installation. Both types of local anesthesia treat discomfort.
Post-Treatment Sensation PCL threads are also stiffer and may be perceived more significantly by
patients in the beginning. The PDO threads also tend to be less noticeable because the threads
become softer. For better quality and fast delivery times, you can contact this PDO thread supplier.
The majority of sensations fade within days, regardless of the thread type. Recovery Experience Both
types of threads have similar recovery timelines. Swelling and bruising generally resolve in 1 week.
The stiffer structure of PCL can result in a slightly longer adjustment.   Cost Considerations  
Treatment Pricing PCL threads are usually more expensive than PDO threads per treatment. The
increase in material costs and the resulting durability should justify higher prices. PDO has
lower-cost alternatives.

## Nature's Hidden Economy

What is nature worth? It's both priceless and worth many trillions. Here's how it props up our lives
and economies, and what we can do to help it.

[ Invest in Nature ][59]
see our work in Maryland and D.C.

## Stepping Up Progress in this Defining Decade

Alongside communities, we’re urgently clearing obstacles and finding solutions to the climate and
biodiversity crises.

[Who We Are][60]

We are dedicated staff, scientists and members advancing effective, lasting conservation in more
than 80 countries and territories.

[What We Do][61]

To make the highest possible impact on the climate and biodiversity crises between now and 2030,
we’re developing breakthrough ideas, amplifying local leaders and influencing policy.

[How To Help][62]

There are so many ways to make positive change for our planet. Volunteer with us. Learn how to
reduce your carbon footprint. Donate to conservation work.

[Where We Work][63]

Dense rainforests, remote coral reefs and the hearts of major cities. Our strategies are as diverse
as the habitats and geographies in which we work.

Cascade Head Preserve Forest located on The Nature Conservancy’s Cascade Head Preserve, north of
Lincoln City, Oregon. © Devan King/TNC

**U.S Standard Shipping:** 4 - 7 Business Days

HOW IS ALPHA TATTOO CARE DIFFERENT

Simple - There's nothing else like it in the tattoo industry. Alpha Tattoo Care was developed by
combining expert insights from tattoo artists, cosmetic chemists, and dermatologists. This
collaboration led to rigorous split testing against every other tattoo care product on the market,
ensuring Alpha Tattoo Care not only meets but surpasses industry standards. Alpha Tattoo Oil for
example, is the first of an entirely new category of tattoo aftercare. Uniquely blending science and
nature, incorporating proprietary Advanced Growth Factor Technology with a mix of natural and
organic ingredients. Unlike standard aftercare products, it's specifically designed to address the
needs of tattooed skin, offering pain relief, accelerated healing, and protection against infection.
Its effectiveness against 99.99% of harmful bacteria, including Staph, Strep, and MRSA, sets a new
standard in tattoo aftercare. By choosing Alpha Tattoo Care, you benefit from a product perfected
through professional expertise and dedicated research, making it a easy choice for your tattoo
aftercare needs. The next generation of tattoo care is here.

WHAT IS THE BEST TATTOO AFTERCARE PROTOCOL

It's important to not only follow your artists instructions, but to also educate yourself.

Please see our [Tattoo After Care Guide.][79]

HOW LONG DOES PAINLESS TATTOO™ NUMBING CREAM WORK FOR?

3 - 4 hours on average. Some say longer. [Directions of use][80] are important in order to be
affective for maximum amount of time. Like, putting the cream on 2 hours in advance.. For example,

By [StaySA][31]

On [June 29, 2026][32]

In [Finance][33]

When financial pressure builds, people often look for immediate, localised assistance rather than
long-term abstract advice. This is where the search for a [debt counsellor near me][34] becomes
common. It usually reflects a situation where monthly obligations are no longer manageable and there
is concern about missed payments, calls from creditors, or letters threatening legal action.

In South Africa, debt problems rarely escalate overnight. They tend to build gradually through
missed instalments, increased living costs, and unexpected expenses. By the time consumers actively
seek help, there is often already pressure from multiple creditors. Understanding this timing is
important, because early intervention can significantly change the outcome of a debt situation.

## Why household budgets often collapse without warning

Many consumers underestimate how quickly financial stability can change when essential costs begin
to rise. Fuel, food, electricity, school expenses, and transport costs often fluctuate in ways that
are not fully accounted for in monthly budgeting. When these essentials increase, disposable income
shrinks, and debt repayments become harder to maintain.

Debit orders are usually the first pressure point. They are fixed obligations that continue
regardless of income changes. When income remains stable but expenses increase, a gap forms. That
gap is often filled with short-term borrowing, delayed payments, or partial instalments. Over time,
this cycle leads to arrears.

Another important factor is the lack of accurate budgeting. Many households rely on estimated
figures rather than tracking actual spending. This can create a false sense of affordability. When
creditors begin applying penalty interest or missed-payment fees, the situation accelerates quickly.
At this stage, consumers often begin searching for a debt counsellor near you because the financial
pressure feels unmanageable and immediate.

**Bridging the gap between the tattoo industry and advanced dermatology care.**

**Appreciate the Art.**

We maintain a fiercely independent approach to product research and development. Our team of skilled
chemical scientists conceptualizes product ideas, researching blends, and creating prototypes. We
source ingredients from the most reputable suppliers across the globe, then marry contemporary
technology with long-established scientific practices.

[Tac Sciences Tattoo Anesthetic Cream Jar]

Developed in collaboration with board-certified dermatologists and industry-leading tattoo artists
to ensure fast and effective pain relief.

One of the main reasons people do not get tattoos is because of the pain associated with the
application. However, with this professional tattoo numbing solution by TAC, you can give your
customers the beautiful tattoo they’ve always wanted without the pain that they fear.

## Safe + Effective

The only tattoo anesthetic cream suitable for use during the shading session.

#### Tattoo Anesthetic Cream

Clinical strength topical anesthetic cream that targets and neutralizes tattoo pain at the source.
TAC Sciences Tattoo Anesthetic Cream is available in individually packaged 1-ounce jars and 0.25
single use packets to professionally licensed tattoo artists and tattoo shops.

## TattooNumbx

Our Tattoo Numbing Cream has been designed by tattoo artists in the US and is used to make
tattooing/procedures comfortable. Our numbing cream is used to help you sit longer through a tattoo
session, so you can get more done. The cream has a lightweight, non-greasy formula that doesn’t
leave the skin oily and does not affect the artist, ink, or the healing of the tattoo. It can be
applied to any area for temporary relief. 

TattooNumbx [Tattoo Numbing Cream][26] can be used for tattoos, laser tattoo removal, cosmetic
tattooing, microneedling, waxing, and a wide range of cosmetic procedures. Once applied, the numbing
cream starts working in as little as 30 minutes and lasts anywhere between 3 and 5 hours (some
people have said it lasts longer). The cream can be reapplied for longer sessions. 

All our numbing cream products have genuine holographic, anti-counterfeit labels that can be
verified. TattooNumbx also offers a wide range of products for tattoos/treatments
including [Aftercare Gel][27], [Aftercare Balm][28], Numbing Spray & tattooist

What is tattoo numbing cream used for?

uses too. Suitable for use anywhere on the body when used as directed, it is commonly applied before
laser tattoo removal, laser hair removal, waxing, injections, blood tests, vaccinations, lip
fillers, permanent makeup, piercings, and other cosmetic skin treatments.

How long should I leave tattoo numbing cream on for?

TattooNumbx should be applied at least 60 minutes before your tattoo session. For best results, we
recommend applying it 90 minutes before your appointment. For procedures longer than 3 hours, the
cream should be reapplied as directed to the area.

Will the tattoo numbing cream effect my ink?

No. Our tattoo numbing cream works alongside the tattooing process without affecting your ink,
tattoo results, or the skin’s natural healing process.

Our tattoo numbing cream lasts for up to 3–5 hours if applied as directed. Over time, the effects
will gradually wear off and sensitivity will start to return to the application area.

How much will one tube of tattoo numbing cream cover?

TattooNumbx - 10g tube, is enough to cover the area of the forearm if applied with a thick layer as
directed.

## QUESTIONS?

How do I know that these are original? There are so many websites claiming they are the original

We only sell original TKTX you can check your purchase with the following:
* QR-code on box & tube
* Golden seal
* Website on the tube
* Different % and price per color (higher percentage = stronger)
* We ONLY sell on **tktx.co**
* Our ONLY instagram **@tktx.europe**
  [more info about fake’s here][81]

My order is stuck on "at shippers warehouse" or "waiting to be shipped"

Please don’t worry, your order is on the way but the tracking updates once it arrives in your
country. If you have received the tracking number : Your order is on the way!

EUROPEAN UNION: Do I have to pay VAT/TAX

No, it is all included. We ship from within Europe

OUTSIDE EU: Do I have to pay VAT/TAX

Depends on your local government laws. Most of the time small parcels pass through without any
problem. We put a low value on the shipping label.

What is the difference between the percentages and colors
* Blue 20%: numbs 1 to 2 hours (normal)
* White 35%: numbs 2 to 3 hours (strong)
* Gold 38%: numbs 3 to 4 hours (extra strong)
* Green 40%: numbs 3 to 5 hours (extra strong, new recipe)
* Mithra 45%: numbs 3,5 to 5,5 hours (extra+ strong)

Hours indicated can be different from person and place of application

Difference between MITHRA+ & TKTX

After producing Mithra+ for years for our partner, we have decided to join both companies. Mithra+
is a thicker pink cream compared to TKTX (white cream) which is also slightly more numbing.

For which applications can I use TKTX or Mithra numbing cream

Tattoo, piercing, wax depilation, laser hair removal, permanent make-up, microblading, laser
tattooing, lipfillers

and a work of art is created for life. Even though the tattoo artists believe that pain is a part of
tattooing, they are open to TKTX numbing creams.

## FAQs

What is TKTX numbing cream, and how does it work?

TKTX numbing cream is a topical anesthetic designed to temporarily reduce sensation in the skin. It
works by penetrating the skin and blocking nerve signals, helping reduce discomfort during tattoos,
PMU, waxing, or other cosmetic procedures.

How long does the numbness from TKTX last?

The duration depends on the formula and skin type. Generally, TKTX lasts **2–5 hours**: Blue for
shorter sessions, Black for medium, Greenand Gold for longer sessions.

Which TKTX formula is strongest — Gold, Green, Black, or Blue?

TKTX Gold is the strongest and fastest-acting formula, ideal for experienced users. Green is
balanced for medium to long sessions, and Black is the mildest for sensitive skin.

Is TKTX safe to use for tattooing or PMU (permanent makeup)?

Yes, when used as directed, TKTX is safe for tattoos, microblading, PMU, waxing, and other skin
procedures. Always follow application guidelines and patch test if you have sensitive skin.

How should I apply TKTX correctly for best results?

Apply a thick layer to clean, dry skin. Cover with plastic wrap or a sealing membrane for better
absorption. Wait the recommended 25–40 minutes depending on the formula, then wipe off before
starting the procedure.

How long before my tattoo or PMU session should I apply TKTX?

Typically, apply TKTX **25–40 minutes before the procedure**. Gold may activate faster, while Green
may need slightly more time.

Can TKTX be used on sensitive skin or sensitive areas?

Yes, but choose the milder formulas (Black or Green) for sensitive areas. Avoid broken or irritated
skin.

Will using TKTX affect the quality of the tattoo ink or healing process?

When applied correctly and wiped off before tattooing, TKTX does **not affect ink quality or
healing**. Always follow proper professional guidance.

How many hours before my session do I need to wait after applying TKTX?

Apply TKTX about **25–40 minutes** prior to the session and wipe off before starting. Numbness can
last **2–5 hours** depending on the formula.

Can I apply TKTX multiple times on the same area?

Generally, one application is sufficient. Reapplying is not recommended unless advised by a
professional, as overuse may increase irritation risk.

Does TKTX work better under plastic wrap or with a sealing membrane?

Yes. Covering the cream with plastic wrap improves absorption and ensures deeper, longer-lasting
numbness.

Does TKTX expire, and how should it be stored?

TKTX has a shelf life of about **2 years**. Store in a **cool, dry place**, away from direct
sunlight, heat, or moisture.

How to distinguish real TKTX from fake numbing creams?

Always buy from **verified sellers**. Authentic TKTX packaging is clear, with batch numbers and
official branding. Avoid suspiciously cheap sources or unverified online stores.

Typically, apply TKTX **25–40 minutes before the procedure**. Gold may activate faster, while Green
may need slightly more time.

Can TKTX be used on sensitive skin or sensitive areas?

Yes, but choose the milder formulas (Black or Green) for sensitive areas. Avoid broken or irritated
skin.

Will using TKTX affect the quality of the tattoo ink or healing process?

When applied correctly and wiped off before tattooing, TKTX does **not affect ink quality or
healing**. Always follow proper professional guidance.

How many hours before my session do I need to wait after applying TKTX?

Apply TKTX about **25–40 minutes** prior to the session and wipe off before starting. Numbness can
last **2–5 hours** depending on the formula.

Can I apply TKTX multiple times on the same area?

Generally, one application is sufficient. Reapplying is not recommended unless advised by a
professional, as overuse may increase irritation risk.

Does TKTX work better under plastic wrap or with a sealing membrane?

Yes. Covering the cream with plastic wrap improves absorption and ensures deeper, longer-lasting
numbness.

Does TKTX expire, and how should it be stored?

TKTX has a shelf life of about **2 years**. Store in a **cool, dry place**, away from direct
sunlight, heat, or moisture.

How to distinguish real TKTX from fake numbing creams?

Always buy from **verified sellers**. Authentic TKTX packaging is clear, with batch numbers and
official branding. Avoid suspiciously cheap sources or unverified online stores.

## Genuine TKTX Numbing Cream

When it comes to tattoo numbing cream, cheapest doesn’t always mean best! Although you might find
some alleged TKTX creams on websites such as Wish, Etsy, Amazon and eBay that sell them for half the
price of TKTX Official, you can’t trust them. Fake sites often take your money and don’t ship
anything – anything they do ship can cause serious harm, affect the ink and your skin and quite
often don’t work at all. Here at TKTX Official we are proud to be the only certified distributor of
TKTX numbing cream.

Some of the advertised fake creams are even called ‘TKTX’ – they may even look similar to our site.
When looking to buy a numbing cream you need to make sure you are thoroughly checking every aspect
of the cream and website. With similar packaging and fake certificates and holograms, the TKTK cream
could easily be mistaken for TKTX if full attention is not given. See our FAQ’s for more info!

## Genuine TKTX Numbing Cream

When it comes to tattoo numbing cream, cheapest doesn’t always mean best! Although you might find
some alleged TKTX creams on websites such as Wish, Etsy, Amazon and eBay that sell them for half the
price of TKTX Official, you can’t trust them. Fake sites often take your money and don’t ship
anything – anything they do ship can cause serious harm, affect the ink and your skin and quite
often don’t work at all. Here at TKTX Official we are proud to be the only certified distributor of
TKTX numbing cream.

Some of the advertised fake creams are even called ‘TKTX’ – they may even look similar to our site.
When looking to buy a numbing cream you need to make sure you are thoroughly checking every aspect
of the cream and website. With similar packaging and fake certificates and holograms, the TKTK cream
could easily be mistaken for TKTX if full attention is not given. See our FAQ’s for more info!

a ‘how to apply’ leaflet with your order.

## Which Colour Is Best For Tattoos?

Yellow is our strongest deep numb, perfect for tattoos and piercings.

## Which colour is best for aesthetics?

Gold or red are our best fast numbs – ideal for aesthetic procedures.

## Why don't you sell TKTX Green?

99% of the sites that are selling greens are selling fakes. This is because the authentic green is
7% lidocaine making it illegal to be sold. This high percentage of lidocaine can be dangerous to
use. We sell the yellow which is the same strength as green but made with 3 different numbing
agents, instead of just the 1.
